scenicChapters.title: Sikkim Silk Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 23 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Sikkim Silk Route
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 4310 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

sikkim-silk-route.story: 74 km one way from Gangtok - plan on about 1 h 14 of riding. On the way it passes Tsomgo Lake, Nathu La and Zuluk. The highest point is about 4,300 m. It crosses from India into China - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
